This page lists 145 Adobe Illustrator keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `illustrator.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Adobe Illustrator to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t illustrator.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/illustrator.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Adobe Illustrator 2024/Adobe Illustrator 2024.app`; if Adobe Illustrator lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## File

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘N` | New document |
| `⇧⌘N` | New from template |
| `⌥⌘N` | New without dialog |
| `⌘O` | Open |
| `⌘W` | Close |
| `⌘S` | Save |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save As |
| `⌥⌘S` | Save a Copy |
| `⌥⌘E` | Export for screens |
| `⌥⇧⌘S` | Save for Web |
| `⌘P` | Print |
| `⌘Q` | Exit |

## Template file

The full [`illustrator.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/illustrator.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
